clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance

operational.targets: One uniquely designated fixed point on your plane within 1 mile; only you receive the selected remote sense.
operational.duration: 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No roll. Choose Sight or Hearing when casting; this mode cannot change during the application. Designate the point through direct perception, prior personal knowledge, a reliable map/description, or a precise relative position from a known reference. A uniquely specified unseen point qualifies; an unspecified hidden room does not. No originating sight or line of effect to the point is required. A point inside solid matter is invalid and yields no feed.
operational.effect: Sight lets you perceive from that point in all directions with ordinary local lighting, visibility, cover and obscurity; it grants no darkvision, true sight, wall vision or borrowed creature senses. Hearing follows ordinary local sound paths, barriers, silence, distances and volumes. Your normal local senses continue simultaneously. Blindness suppresses remote Sight and Deafened suppresses remote Hearing while applicable. Maintain the same-plane, 5,280-foot tether between you and the point. Leaving that tether suppresses the feed without ending or pausing the duration; returning restores only current information. Actual subject/area Divination protections withhold protected information within their scope, leaving independently readable information available.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.
operational.limitations: One active Clairvoyance point per caster; a successful new cast replaces the old point. The point remains at its chosen location and cannot move, follow a creature or surface, or search through rooms; all-direction sight permits looking from that one point, not translating it. It is a nonphysical ongoing magical effect without HP, affected only by another effect with actual permission to detect, suppress or end it. Suppression pauses no clock and records no backlog. No remote attacks, interaction, spellcasting origin, line of effect for another power, translation, identity authentication, persistent recording object or replay is granted. A dark/silent/blocked feed does not diagnose its cause. A successful replacement owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F and seeing OR hearing a location within one mile. CONFLICT RULING: explicit one-mile range controls over raw 30 feet. NEW: one minute without concentration replaces Instantaneous metadata; fixed uniquely designated point, immutable mode, same-plane tether and sensory limits. counterspell.name: Counterspell

operational.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves
operational.targets: One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you.
operational.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.
operational.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operational.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. After a failed attempt another eligible creature may react; once negated, the spell supplies no further interruption trigger. All reactions need their own legal remaining resource, components, range and current source permissions. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger. Ordinary Counterspell requires ordinary repertoire/class access and rank-3 cost; Wizard/Mage same-named class cards keep their own separate acquisition, printed costs, ranks, recharge and text. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both Abjuration/Universal rank-3 placements, Reaction, 60 feet, V/S/F and instantaneous interruption. NEW: actual casting ability+PB against DC 10+2*rank, one attempt per pending cast, hidden-rank handling and nested timing. REVIEWED SOURCE CORRECTION: the earlier binary-check proposal is superseded by the existing Core fixed-DC task rule, with natural shifts and collapsed success/failure outcomes. Exact source permission may override the shared attempt limit; another Reaction alone cannot.

acid-arrow.name: Acid Arrow

operational.targets: One creature or independently legal object you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect.
operational.duration: Instantaneous initial attack plus one finite ongoing delayed rank-2 spell rider per successful hit, no concentration. Creature: execute at its first future regular END, excluding its current turn. Object: execute at the caster’s first future regular END, excluding the caster’s current turn. Outside initiative: application +6 seconds. Preserve the original corresponding regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline across entry/exit/reorder, absence, plane change and extra turns.
operational.resolution: Make a ranged spell attack. Miss: no damage or delayed rider. Hit: resolve 4d4 acid, doubling only those initial attack dice on a critical. After that packet, if the same recipient remains the same continuing eligible creature/object, attach the delayed rider unless an actual defense prevents it. Initial damage reduced to 0 does not itself prevent attachment. Merely reaching 0 HP is not automatically death or loss of continuing creature identity. If the initial packet actually kills/ends that creature identity or destroys that object before attachment, no rider is created.
operational.effect: At its scheduled marker, an existing unsuppressed rider deals a separately rolled 2d4 acid to the same continuing recipient as one nonattack packet, then ends. This is an existing-effect consequence, not a cast: no RP, Dissonance, Refrain, cast-begin hook or Counterspell window; ordinary damage/outcome hooks keep their actual predicates. No delayed critical dice. Every qualifying hit has an independent source-owned rider, including same-ID casts by the same or different owners; they coexist rather than refresh or replace. Simultaneous due riders resolve in stable application order as separate packets. An eligible dispel/removal can end a specific pending rank-2 rider before execution despite the source’s Instantaneous cast metadata. Suppression never pauses its marker. If suppressed when due, consume the one-shot event without damage, end that rider, and never replay it after suppression lifts. Movement, lost range/line of effect/perception, caster absence and identity-preserving transformation do not alone end the rider. Actual death/ended continuing creature identity, object destruction or replacement/resummoning ends its recipient’s rider; resurrection/recreation does not inherit it. Actual transformation/source rules may independently end or suppress it.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: No delayed retargeting to a corpse, replacement or last location; no extra-turn acceleration or timing reset; no washing/scraping removal procedure, physical recoverable arrow or mundane acid material. The ordinary attack and delayed packet remain separate. A directly selected object must be perceived, within range and line of effect, and independently legal: unattended, held by the caster, or deliberately offered by a willing holder. This gives no general permission to target hostile worn/carried inventory. Use actual object AC, durability and defenses; the spell does not automatically destroy an object. Actual class/source access, repertoire, level, action availability, components, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. These actual rank-2 placements have base 3 RP; actual source modifiers and strain surcharges still apply. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception, and F is the ordinary class focus. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.

SOURCE-EVIDENCE ADOPTION: possible Melf’s Acid Arrow Core metadata supplies Action/30 feet/V,S,F/Instantaneous without identity/access merger. NEW: ranged attack, miss-none, post-initial-packet attachment, exact one-shot marker, coexistence, dispellable ongoing rider and suppression-at-execution consumption.
